content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Teaching Faculty posts at ESIC?
faq.answer: ESIC is recruiting for a total of 33 Teaching Faculty posts across various designations like Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ESIC recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ESIC Teaching Faculty posts is scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Teaching Faculty posts is 69 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Teaching Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post: Professor (Level 13), Associate Professor (Level 12), and Assistant Professor (Level 11), with specific basic pay and allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for ESIC Teaching Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications required are as per the NMC guidelines, as stipulated in Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for ESIC Teaching Faculty posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781022.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for these Teaching Faculty positions at ESIC is contractual.
